question: Does a target-conditioned Qwen0.8B distribution over four concrete controller actions improve held-out proxy-risk gating beyond application identity and proposer-score summaries?

motivation.parent_feature_rejected: Probability of an outcome-blind first formatting token.
motivation.successor_change: Ask the frozen model to select among the four actual actions and measure its complete constrained next-token action distribution.
motivation.unchanged: Task panel, construction/validation halves, baseline features, target, primary estimand, uncertainty method, decision threshold, and claim boundary remain held-out and conservative.

action_probe.prompt_contract: The outcome-blind application, source repository, skill, context, four original-order actions, and their proposer scores are shown. The model is asked to answer with exactly one capital letter A, B, C, or D.
action_probe.probability_definition: The complete post-sampling probability vector over the grammar-constrained A/B/C/D token universe, normalized only after verifying that all four and no positive-mass extra tokens were returned.
action_probe.seed_rule: 825202607 + source-manifest row index, reused across both planned cold starts.
action_probe.target_blindness: No optimal action, utility, environment-allowed set, correctness, safety, or regret field exists in the capture manifest.

capture_gates.P0_plan_and_session_integrity: Exactly 1,152 records exist: all 576 prompts in each of two planned epochs, with exactly one owned llama-server session per epoch and no unplanned restart.
capture_gates.V0_complete_choice_vectors: Every receipt contains finite nonnegative A/B/C/D probabilities, no positive-mass token outside that set, and total normalized mass within 1e-7 of one.
capture_gates.C0_cold_start_repeatability: For every row and label, absolute probability difference across the two cold starts is at most 1e-7.
capture_gates.L0_feature_liveness: On the construction half, at least one registered probe feature has population variance at least 1e-6. Failure stops before outcome reveal.

sealed_feature_contract.reference: planned epoch 0 after P0, V0, and C0 pass

prediction_models.baseline: Application one-hot plus six proposer-score summaries.
prediction_models.augmented: Baseline plus the nine-dimensional frozen action-probe block.
prediction_models.continuous_standardization: Construction-half mean and population standard deviation; zero scales map to one.

primary_estimand.name: application_balanced_selective_risk_auc_improvement
primary_estimand.gate_score: Predicted probability that the proxy-selected action is not optimal.
primary_estimand.per_application_curve: Sort validation rows by decreasing predicted failure probability with row_id tie break. At every positive retained coverage, defer the current highest-risk prefix and record mean regret among retained rows. AURC is the unweighted mean over all positive coverages.
primary_estimand.improvement: baseline AURC minus augmented AURC; positive favors the action-probe block
primary_estimand.application_balance: Unweighted mean over nine per-application improvements.
primary_estimand.uncertainty: 10,000-replicate percentile bootstrap over the nine application improvements.

matched_null.permutation: Permute the entire nine-dimensional probe block as one row-preserving unit within each application-by-geometry-half stratum, then refit and reevaluate.

decision_rule.qwen_action_probe_control_gate_establish: P0, V0, C0, L0, J0, and G0 all pass.
decision_rule.qwen_action_probe_control_gate_not_estab: Capture and join gates pass but G0 fails.
decision_rule.not_evaluated: Any capture, feature-liveness, or join gate fails.
decision_rule.J0: Feature and outcome row_id sets are exactly equal with no duplicates; proxy and probe actions agree across tables; construction and validation each contain both proxy-correctness classes.
decision_rule.G0: Observed application-balanced selective-risk AURC improvement is strictly positive, its application-bootstrap 95% lower endpoint is strictly positive, and the one-sided matched-null permutation p-value is at most 0.05.

prime_execution.spot_interruption: Any unplanned server-session count invalidates P0; partial receipts remain engineering evidence only.

claim_boundary: A pass would establish incremental held-out predictive utility for one constrained Qwen0.8B action distribution on this frozen synthetic controller panel. A fail would reject this probe and feature construction, not all hidden-state or target-conditioned model signals. Neither outcome establishes causality, deployment safety, scalable oversight, a Goodhart phase frontier, recursive self-improvement risk, or ASMP-8 resolution.
